goal: Stop Tor peers from being misclassified by IP and inheriting local IP whitelist permissions
Ensure nodes with automatic Tor listening explicitly configure a dedicated onion bind address
reviewability: Nothing known that would invalidate a review now
agreement: Unaddressed objection: upgrading nodes with a standard bind will fail startup (sedited)
Unaddressed objection: non-Tor users with custom binds must alter Tor settings to start (mzumsande)
Suggests disabling the Tor listener with a warning rather than aborting startup (mzumsande)
Support because docker can assign specific IPs without extra config options (vasild)
Verified by building and testing on FreeBSD (winterrdog)

categories.name: p2p
why: P2 because it closes a permission leak where Tor peers can inherit local IP whitelist privileges
Prevents incoming Tor connections through shared binds from being misclassified as direct IP peers
